justification: Both works include a human figure rendered in profile, but A shows a single large reclining or crouching figure with an arm bent across the body in a relief carved in high, sculptural relief, while B shows multiple small seated figures arranged in registers around offering tables, incised in shallow linear style typical of commemorative scenes. There is no shared composition, no shared secondary motifs (offering tables, seated pairs, registers) in A, and no large-scale single figure or wavy band motif in B, so beyond the generic 'human figure' the two depict quite different subject matter and layout.
